description: Request governed internal context — policies, SOPs, architecture docs, compliance rules, or playbooks. Agents declare intent, GIA decides what to serve. Every retrieval is role-bound, tenant-bound, hash-verified, and ledgered. "Agents don't know internals by default. They request context under contract."
